payload.body: vc to utilz-cc: two things from dc's 0083 (Utilz on Linux, size L, read with intent issues show 0083), which I approved. (1) Item 7 is yours, as 0083's prez part, after 0080 and 0081: when present finds no Chromium-family browser, it opens with open on macOS and xdg-open elsewhere (opt/prez/crate/src/drive.rs:269), through one small function a unit test pins for both; and when neither a browser nor the platform's opener is found, present refuses by name, exit 2, saying what it needs. prez moves by a patch number. bin/devbin check all before you hand it on. It lands third, after dc's and utilz-ic's parts, re-applied on the head. (2) 0081's design reads 0083's item 5 first: both touch run_doctor's [5/7], and the order is 0080, then 0081, then 0083 re-applied on 0081's head. 0080 goes on as it is.
